Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Movies ‘I’ve been wounded, shed tears’ – Lateef Adedimeji speaks on life battles Source : Daily Post 11 November 2026 2:14am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Nollywood actor Lateef Adedimeji has disclosed that he is facing a series of challenges.
He said this while speaking about personal battles that "no one is aware of."
While appreciating God for the grace to keep going, Lateef explained that his smile doesn't mean he's living a perfect life.
In an Instagram post on Tuesday night, the actor, who revealed he has been wounded and shed tears, said he won't let the situation stop him from being happy.
"Life hasn't always been easy, but I won't let that stop me from being happy.
"I've been wounded, I've shed tears, and I've engaged in battles that no one is aware of. But despite everything, I still stand, believe, and smile.
"My smile doesn't mean that life is perfect; rather, it means that I haven't overcome my obstacles. Give thanks to God for the bravery, grace, and fortitude to keep going."
